result:
**Round 186 (STORE-1a) passes.** I re-ran every C row myself in real Chromium at 1440×900, 1280×720 and 375×812, each in a fresh anonymous session. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. No row needed the real backend, so nothing is blocked.

**What A's three fixes now do**
- **Inactive product:** `/products/archived-rain` returns a real 404 "Not Found" page with no price, Add to Cart or Buy Now. The mock still answered 200 for it, so the store is the one refusing. Active products open as before, with the same variants and prices as round 185.
- **Meta description:** on all three products I checked, the description tags match the product's own text. That holds in the server HTML and after hydration. Title, image, type and category are unchanged, and none of the old marketing phrases remain. The fallback for a missing description only runs in A's unit test, because every mock product has a description.
- **Gift card image:** the page loads `/images/gift-card.png` (1024 px wide). There are no requests to unsplash or any other outside host except Google Fonts.

**Neighbouring checks**
- **Product preview:** the audio actually played, about 2.5 s of progress in 3 s.
- **Premium protection still holds:**
  - Anonymous `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio.
  - The Studio token endpoint gives 401 with no header and 403 with a fake Bearer.
  - This is against the mock, not the real backend.
- **Studio look:** the `/studio-lab` rest shot matches round 185 pixel for pixel at both 1440 and 1280, with 0 console errors.
- **`/store`:** 0 changed pixels at all three sizes. The product page also matches exactly once I repeat round 185's capture, which was taken during playback.
- **Home loading:** largest paint 356–364 ms, layout shift below 0.002, well inside the limits.
- **Unit tests:** A's test file passes 12/12. It fails as expected on the original code and on my own small code changes.
- **File scope:** only the 2 granted files are modified plus the 2 new files, and every other tracked file is unchanged.

**One weaker spot.** Round 185's "before" shots of the home page are blank below the hero, because the sections there never animated in. So for the Special Offers section I couldn't do a true before/after.
- At 1440 and 1280, an in-page test (image shown vs hidden) changes nothing outside the gift card.
- At 375 the page keeps moving, so that test isn't usable there. That viewport rests on the text and box positions being identical with and without the image.
- I saved scrolled full-page shots to use as the baseline next time.

**Two new Low findings for B**
- **C-R186-01:** active Door Slams (price 9, no variants) shows "TOTAL PRICE $0.00" with working Add to Cart and Buy Now.
  - The cause is `ProductDetailPage.tsx` l.67–69, older code this round didn't touch. Round 185 never opened this page, so it's newly seen, not a regression.
  - It's only Low because products without variants exist only in the mock so far. If the real backend ever sends one, it becomes Medium, since it's the purchase path.
- **C-R186-02:** on the gift card, the paragraph drops to 2.59:1 contrast (2.22:1 at 375) where it crosses the gold "CZABA" lettering in the new image. That's about 2–3 % of the text area; the heading is fine. The overlay is unchanged and is STORE-2's job.

I started the mock API and stopped it at the end, edited no app source, and made no commit or push. The full-suite, build and verify rows are left to the root gate, which hasn't run yet.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-186.md
- c-round-186.json
- c-round-186/
